summary.en: On a quest to get to a Yoko Okino concert Kogoro breaks his foot, while the Detective Boys visit the hospital, they are unaware that a patient in Kogoro's room is one of the bank robbers. Along the way, a visiting father is separated from his daughter by the remaining robbers, and the only way he can get her back is by murdering the robber. Robbery - Hostage Situation Victim: Yumiko Sekiguchi Suspects: Robber gang
